arcs.title: Dana and the basil cups
arcs.stage: 2/5 — He noticed the leaf on Friday; today he bumps into Dana in the park and finally asks why basil.

arcs.title: Saving Moshe
arcs.stage: 1/3 — Moshe is wilting; Ishai overwaters and gives him pep talks. Dana hints she knows plants.

arcs.title: The big client
arcs.stage: 1/4 — Motzei Shabbat email: the logo must be 'bigger but smaller' again.

arcs.title: Getting a TV
arcs.stage: Sunday Nov 1, 09:30–12:30 — Avi's cousin brings the old TV.

arcs.title: Falafel the dog
arcs.stage: Today: the stray appears at Avi's kiosk. Sunday: adoption.

beats.goal: Slow Shabbat morning, no work, no rushing. Ishai wakes late, makes coffee, finishes leftover challah from last night with Noa, and checks on Moshe the basil on the windowsill. Moshe looks droopier. Ishai waters him (again, too much) and gives him a sincere pep talk out loud.
beats.forceText: Ishai kneels by the windowsill with a glass of water and gives Moshe the basil a quiet pep talk.

forceLines.say: Come on, Moshe. It's Shabbat. Even you get to rest. Just... rest upright.

forceCommentary.say: That's his third glass of water. Moshe is not wilting, he's drowning.
A man talking to a plant on Shabbat morning. Dana needs to see this.

beats.goal: On a slow Shabbat walk Ishai stops by Avi's kiosk and notices a scruffy sandy stray dog hanging around. Avi admits he has been secretly feeding it falafel balls. Ishai kneels, the dog sniffs him and decides he is acceptable. Ishai pretends not to be charmed. Complete when the stray has clearly entered the story.
beats.forceText: By Avi's kiosk, a scruffy sandy stray sits and stares at Ishai like they have met before.

forceLines.say: Don't look at me, champion. He showed up Tuesday. Now he's family.

forceCommentary.say: A stray dog and a lonely designer. I'm not saying it's destiny. I'm saying it's destiny.
Moshe the basil will not take this well.

beats.goal: Shabbat afternoon walk: Ishai goes apartment -> corridor -> street -> park to read on a bench. Dana, off work, walks through the park and recognizes him. Short, awkward, real: he asks why she draws basil on his cups; she shrugs it off, then reveals she knows plants. He mentions Moshe is dying; she gives one dry tip (stop drowning him). Keep it shy, no date yet.
beats.forceText: On a park bench, Ishai looks up from his book. Dana, off duty, stops in front of him with the faintest smile.

forceLines.say: Why basil? On my cups. Why basil?
You look like a guy who kills basil. Stop overwatering it.

forceCommentary.say: OUTSIDE THE CAFE. Off the clock. In the wild. I'm screaming.
She diagnosed Moshe from across a park. Marry her or hire her.

beats.goal: After dark (three stars, about 17:35) Ishai makes a simple, sincere havdalah at home: a cup, a braided candle if he has one, smelling spices, a short blessing. Then 'Shavua tov' and he reaches for his phone again.
beats.forceText: Three stars are out. Ishai makes a short havdalah at the kitchen counter, then exhales: Shavua tov.

forceLines.say: Shavua tov, Moshe. New week. You can do this.

forceCommentary.say: Shabbat's over. The phone is back. The emails are coming.
Week one hundred sixty of Ishai being a better Jew than me.

beats.goal: Motzei Shabbat: Ishai opens his laptop and finds a long email from the big client: the logo must be 'bigger, but also smaller, but more premium'. He reads it aloud in disbelief, tries a few versions, and grumbles to Moshe. He needs the money for a TV, so he does not say no.
beats.forceText: Ishai stares at the laptop. The client wants the logo bigger, but smaller. He reads it twice.

forceLines.say: 'Bigger, but smaller, but more premium.' Moshe, what does that even mean?

forceCommentary.say: Bigger but smaller. The client wants a Schrodinger's logo.
Saturday night and he's working. Dana would never let this happen.

beats.goal: Ishai can't stop thinking about the stray. He goes back to Avi's kiosk, gets Avi's blessing, names the dog Falafel and brings him home through the building corridor (Mrs. Levi has strong opinions about dogs and then falls in love). Spread it over several moments. Complete in the moment Falafel arrives in apartment 4.
beats.forceText: Ishai carries the scruffy stray up to apartment 4 and sets him down. 'Welcome home, Falafel.' Moshe the basil has a new roommate.

forceCommentary.say: HE ADOPTED THE DOG. I need a minute. I need several minutes.
Falafel. He named a dog after lunch. Respect.
